header.contentDescription: A complete mechanical watch movement drawn as an X-ray, built outwards from its escapement: the mainspring barrel, the going train of centre, third and fourth wheels, the lever escapement with its balance and hairspring, the motion work that divides the hours from the minutes, and a dial with three hands. Every wheel turns at the ratio of the teeth drawn on it.
